headline: Earnings swing to a loss
summary_short: Indian Oil Corporation reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of -₹1.18, down from ₹4.95 a year earlier and ₹10.50 last quarter.
summary_long: EPS of -₹1.18 marks a swing to a loss from ₹4.95 a year earlier (-123.8% y/y) and from ₹10.50 in the prior quarter (-111.2% q/q). This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
